Mixed-model lenses

Random-effects lenses — a single random intercept and the breeder-standard multi-environment-trial (MET) structure of two crossed/nested intercepts. The marginal lens integrates the random effects out; the NIMBLE lens samples them; the robust-RE lens gives them heavy tails.

fit_glmm_marginal()
Fit the marginal mixed-model lens
fit_nimble_glmm()
Fit the NIMBLE GLMM lens
fit_glmm_robust_re()
Fit the heavy-tailed random-effect lens (Student-t random intercepts)
koine_pass_from_design()
Construct a koine pass from design arrays (the IR-targetable builder)
